newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela seen exporting 3.03 mln bpd in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela seen exporting 3.03 mln bpd in 1997.

text.p: Venezuela plans to export an average of 3.03 million barrels per day (bpd) of crudes and products according to official estimates used to calculate the government's 1997 budget.

State-owned oil company PdVSA expects to pump 3.416 million bpd, of which 355,000 bpd is earmarked for domestic consumption and the rest for export, according to sources present at a closed door meeting between PdVSA President Luis Giusti and the Congressional Finance Commission.
Average exports this year reached 2.739 million bpd according to figures obtained by Reuters.
PdVSA estimates its fiscal contribution for 1997 will range between 4.5 to 4.9 trillion bolivars ($9.6 - $10.4 billion), the source added.
